prompt: Implement `TTLCache(capacity, ttl, clock)` in solution.py. set(key, value) stores a value that expires ttl seconds later (per the injected clock); get(key, default) returns it, or default when missing or expired. When a set exceeds capacity, evict the least recently used entry, counting both get and set as use. len() counts only live entries. Raise ValueError for a non-positive capacity or ttl.
acceptance: expired entries read as missing and are dropped
capacity eviction is least-recently-used and reads refresh recency
re-setting a key refreshes its expiry
